notes:
The bag says what things are. Most gear and consumables come back from the engine with an empty name, so the Bag tab read "#205" eighty-one times; item names are now resolved from the game's own tables and #205 is a Wyvern Chain.

New: !armysize [20|50|100] uses an Army Size Boost, and !use <item> [count] uses anything in the bag. An ambiguous name is refused with the candidates listed rather than resolved to the closest one, quantity defaults to 1 and cannot exceed the bag, and !use ships off by default.

Fixed: a wonder whose name ends in a digit. "!rein Border Station 10 5 6 9 10k" read the station's own 10 as a troop weight and aimed at nothing.
